reuse.why: Reuses getSheetValue, setBudget, isTrackingBudget, batchMessages and the mutator/undoable wiring, but there is no shared category-selection helper and it re-copies the selection query instead of extracting one.

duplication.why: The hidden/goal_def category SQL and the income-skip loop are a fifth copy of the block already repeated in setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration and a test are added.

maintainability.why: Readable and consistent with neighbours, but a change to which categories month-wide actions fill now has to be made in one more copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing shared selection abstraction exists; it uses the existing setBudget/getSheetValue helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied category query and income-skip loop in setLastMonthSpending are verbatim copies, not disguised.
